title: Derivative and total influence
statement: Let $p\\in(0,1)$, and let $f$ be a monotone function from $\\{-1,1\\}^n$ to $\\{-1,1\\}$. The biased minus-probability polynomial $Q_f$ is differentiable at $p$ with derivative $\\mathrm{Inf}_p(f)/\\sigma(p)^2$, where $\\mathrm{Inf}_p(f)$ is the total influence of the real-valued sign representation of $f$ under the biased product measure with parameter $p$, and $\\sigma(p)=\\sqrt{4p(1-p)}$.
